# Organizational risk context

## Risk tolerance

The program accepts moderate residual risk for developmental systems with a POA&M
[[product/README.md]].

## Common controls

The enclave provides boundary protection and SIEM monitoring as common controls
[[product/architecture.md#boundary]].

## Roles

The CIO appoints the AO, who names an AODR; the program office provides the ISSM and ISSO
[[INT-013.A1]].

## Risk management strategy

Moderate residual risk is acceptable for developmental systems with a dated POA&M
[[INT-014.A1]].

## Organizational risk assessment

Compromised field units and insider misuse of administrator accounts are the organizational
threats of concern [[INT-015.A1]].

## Tailored baselines

No organization-wide tailored baseline applies; programs start from the CNSSI 1253
selection [[INT-016.A1]].

## Common control identification

The analysis enclave offers boundary protection and SIEM monitoring as common controls
[[INT-017.A1]].

## Continuous monitoring strategy

Monthly vulnerability scans, quarterly assessment of a third of the baseline and a
quarterly status report to the AO [[INT-018.A1]].
